caseTitle: Marie Bautista - Individual Income Tax Classification
caseSummary: Marie Bautista, a local BPO employee, needs her taxpayer classification confirmed before her annual income tax return can be processed. She has lived and worked in the Philippines her entire life and earns income solely from her employer, so the case centers on correctly identifying her residency status and taxpayer type rather than on any financial discrepancies.

documents.documentName: Certificate of Compensation Payment/Tax Withheld (BIR Form 2316)

fields.label: Length of Residency in the Philippines

potentialIssues: Marie's income comes entirely from a single local employer, with no other sources of income to account for.
Her taxpayer classification depends on confirming both her citizenship and her Philippine residency.
Because tax was already properly withheld by her employer, there should be no additional tax payable once the classification is confirmed.
The player must correctly identify her as a Resident Citizen taxed on compensation income under the graduated income tax table.
No deductions, adjustments, or unsupported expenses are involved in this case — the focus is entirely on correct classification.
_emotes: Any dialogue line may add "emote": heart, sparkles, alert, question, thinking, idea, sweat, worried, annoyed or music (a small icon over the speaker while the line shows), and "burst": true for a peak moment only. Lines without one show nothing; unknown names are ignored with a warning.

receptionistGreeting.speaker: Npc
receptionistGreeting.text: Welcome to the office! You must be our new tax consultant.

receptionistGreeting.speaker: Npc
receptionistGreeting.text: Word travels fast around here. Everyone's saying you did great in the plaza!

receptionistGreeting.speaker: Npc
receptionistGreeting.text: Remember Marie, from outside? She's your first case. Her case folder is already on your desk.

clientFirstMeeting.speaker: Player
clientFirstMeeting.text: Good afternoon. Mind if I ask you a few questions? I'm the new tax consultant assigned to the town.

clientFirstMeeting.speaker: Npc
clientFirstMeeting.text: Oh, sure. Is there something I need to prepare?

clientFirstMeeting.speaker: Player
clientFirstMeeting.text: Nothing serious. I'm getting familiar with the taxpayers around here. What do you do for a living?

clientFirstMeeting.speaker: Npc
clientFirstMeeting.text: I work at the BPO office nearby. I've been there for a few years now.

interviewLines.speaker: Player
interviewLines.text: I see. And have you been living here in the Philippines for most of your life?

interviewLines.speaker: Npc
interviewLines.text: Yes. I was born here, actually. My family and I have always lived here.

interviewLines.speaker: Player
interviewLines.text: Got it. That gives me a better idea of your taxpayer status. Thanks for your time.

interviewLines.speaker: Npc
interviewLines.text: No problem. Good luck with your new job!

outcomeCorrectNoIssues.speaker: Player
outcomeCorrectNoIssues.text: Marie is a Resident Citizen earning compensation income from a single local employer. Her tax was properly withheld, so her return is ready for filing with no further adjustments needed.

outcomeCorrectNoIssues.speaker: Npc
outcomeCorrectNoIssues.text: That's a relief! Thanks for looking into it properly.

outcomeCorrectWithIssues.speaker: Player
outcomeCorrectWithIssues.text: Marie's classification as a Resident Citizen is correct, but a few details still need to be double-checked before finalizing the return.

outcomeCorrectWithIssues.speaker: Npc
outcomeCorrectWithIssues.text: Oh, is something missing from my documents?

outcomeCorrectWithIssues.speaker: Player
outcomeCorrectWithIssues.text: Just some minor confirmations on the employment records. Nothing that should cause any issues.

outcomeCorrectWithIssues.speaker: Npc
outcomeCorrectWithIssues.text: Okay, just let me know if you need anything else from me.

outcomeWrongVerdict.speaker: Player
outcomeWrongVerdict.text: The assessment doesn't correctly reflect Marie's taxpayer classification.

outcomeWrongVerdict.speaker: Npc
outcomeWrongVerdict.text: I don't understand — I've lived here my whole life and only have one job. Did I do something wrong?

outcomeWrongVerdict.speaker: Player
outcomeWrongVerdict.text: No, nothing on your end. A Filipino citizen who resides in the Philippines and earns compensation income here should be classified as a Resident Citizen — that determines how your income is taxed.

outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.speaker: Player
outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.text: The assessment is incorrect, and a few supporting details were also overlooked.

outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.speaker: Npc
outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.text: That sounds more complicated than I expected.

outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.speaker: Player
outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.text: It shouldn't be, in your case — your situation is fairly simple. I'll need to review your employer records and residency details again before finalizing your classification.

outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.speaker: Npc
outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.text: All right, let me know if you need anything else.

_consequences: Level 1 Phase 3. Marie's talk after a failed audit (her story again as clues, never the answer), her bubbles, what each mistake would mean in real life (Audit Summary), and the Auditor's lines that get stricter on each failed try (the last repeats).

clientAfterFailedAudit.speaker: Npc
clientAfterFailedAudit.text: The Auditor said something was off with my file... Did I tell you something wrong?

clientAfterFailedAudit.speaker: Player
clientAfterFailedAudit.text: Not at all. I just need to take another look. Can you remind me about your work?

clientAfterFailedAudit.speaker: Npc
clientAfterFailedAudit.text: I've only ever had one job: the night shift at the BPO, with my salary every payday. No business on the side.

clientAfterFailedAudit.speaker: Npc
clientAfterFailedAudit.text: And I've lived in this town my whole life. My passport has never even been stamped!

clientAfterFailedAudit.speaker: Player
clientAfterFailedAudit.text: That helps a lot. Leave it to me.

clientAfterFailedAudit.speaker: Npc
clientAfterFailedAudit.text: Thank you. I'll be right here.

clientFailedBubble: Something's off with my file? Oh no... I'll be in the conference room if you need me!
clientApprovedBubble: My file's approved? Thank you so much! Karaoke is on me this weekend!
_requiredFields: What the Auditor grades, in this order. key = residencyStatus, taxpayerType, incomeSource, numberOfEmployers, businessRegistration, taxOption or requiredForm (its answer comes from answerKey and must be a valid value, or the case will not load). hint = the Auditor's line when it is missing or wrong (never the answer). mistakeCost = what it would mean in real life (Audit Summary). Leave the list out to use the Level 1 three.

requiredFields.hint: Review the taxpayer's background and living situation.
requiredFields.mistakeCost: get where Marie belongs and lives wrong, and she could be taxed on the wrong income, or miss what she's owed.

requiredFields.hint: Look for details that help identify the taxpayer's classification.
requiredFields.mistakeCost: the wrong taxpayer type puts Marie's return under the wrong rules and forms, and that can mean penalties she doesn't deserve.

requiredFields.hint: Review how the taxpayer earns income.
requiredFields.mistakeCost: mix up how Marie earns her money, and her return reports the wrong income, with surcharges and interest to follow.

_auditorApprovedLines: What the Auditor says when the case is approved (in order). Leave empty for the built-in lines.
auditorApprovedLines: Excellent work! I've reviewed your case, and everything is correct.
Congratulations! You know your taxpayer. You correctly identified their residency, classification, and how they earn their income — that's the foundation every accurate filing is built on.
auditorRetryLines: This case isn't quite ready yet. Take another look, and don't worry: you can go back and work through it again.
Second try, and still not right. Did you check her profile and the Tax Code Book this time?
Slow down. Talk to your client, read her profile again, then match it to the book. I want careful work, not guesses.
auditorSameAnswersLine: These are the exact same answers you gave me last time. Change what's wrong first, then come back.
_consultation: T23: visiting Marie in the conference room during her case (after the side quest, before approval). Each visit picks ONE entry in this order: a clue that fits (document = a documents[].documentName while it is unread; field = a case folder key such as ResidencyStatus while it is empty or wrong; each clue once until the next reset), then a special moment (failedAudit after a failed audit, laterDay on Office Hours day 2+), then the visit ladder (1st helpful, 2nd friendly, 3rd teasing, 4th playful, 5th+ redirect; the last step repeats). A failed audit or a new day restarts the ladder. The line just said is never picked again next. Ids must be unique. Clues are hints only: never write an answer (Resident Citizen, Compensation Earner, Employment Income). Visiting never changes trust, coins, XP, score or time.

lines.speaker: Npc

lines.speaker: Npc

lines.speaker: Player

_clientFinale: End-of-level scene: Marie (the plaza model) in the conference room on the left, the Level Complete card on the right. Her lines depend on the result: great = first try and on time; good = one slip (one failed audit, or one day late); okay = more slips. screenLeft = where she stands across the screen (0 left, 0.5 centre). distanceScale: 1 = default, bigger = camera farther back. floorPath = the room floor she stands on. farewellGreat / farewellGood / farewellOkay = her goodbye beside the card after the Client Copy handover (each line may have an emote).

_clientHandover: After approval (story only): when the Audit Summary closes the Auditor explains the approval (approvalGreat / approvalGood / approvalOkay by result, as in clientFinale), then auditorGive, and the read-only client copy drops beside him when his conversation ends (auditorGive alone when asked again before pickup; auditorRemind when asked again once you carry it; waiting = Marie before you picked it up), you carry it to Marie in the conference room and talk to her: opening lines, then the handover line waits until you drag the copy onto her (or tap the folder icon); handoverPrompt is shown meanwhile, retryPrompt if saving failed. Then explain (Elijah), then her clientFinale lines for your result with greatEmote / goodEmote / okayEmote on the first one.
